title: Improving Early Detection of Scientifically Interesting Radio Sources Using Enhanced Isolation Forest
abstract: arXiv:2611.21674v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The rapid growth of radio astronomical surveys has created a major challenge in identifying scientifically interesting sources from large populations of observed objects. This study investigates whether enhanced Isolation Forest (iForest) methods can improve the early detection and ranking of scientifically interesting radio sources. Four iForest variants, Standard Enhanced, Pooled Gain, Kurtosis-based, and Hypervolume, are evaluated using 1,031 extended radio sources from the MeerKAT Galaxy Cluster Legacy Survey (MGCLS). Each source is represented by a 52-dimensional feature set derived using Bootstrap Your Own Latent (BYOL) self-supervised learning and principal component analysis (PCA), while expert scientific-interest ratings are used to define the ground-truth labels. The methods are evaluated using Average Precision (AP), receiver operating characteristic area under the curve (ROC AUC), Precision@10, Precision@50, and cumulative

translated_title: 使用增强孤立森林改进具有科学价值射电源的早期检测
translated_abstract: 射电天文巡天的快速发展，使得从大量观测天体中识别具有科学价值的源成为一项重大挑战。本研究探讨了增强孤立森林方法能否改善具有科学价值射电源的早期检测与排序。研究基于MeerKAT星系团遗产巡天（MGCLS）中的1,031个延展射电源，评估了四种孤立森林变体：标准增强版、池化增益版、基于峰度的版本以及超体积版本。每个源由通过BYOL自监督学习与主成分分析（PCA）导出的52维特征集来表示，并以专家的科学价值评级作为真实标签。这些方法采用平均精度（AP）、受试者工作特征曲线下面积（ROC AUC）、Precision@10、Precision@50以及累积
tldr: 本研究提出并评估了四种增强孤立森林变体，结合BYOL自监督学习提取的特征与MGCLS巡天数据，有效提升了具有科学价值射电源的早期检测与排序效果。
en_tdlr: This study evaluates four enhanced Isolation Forest variants combined with BYOL self-supervised features on MGCLS data to improve the early detection and ranking of scientifically interesting radio sources.
